title: az devops team list --project ${project} --top 21 --output json
description: The project's teams, the first 21, so a 21st says there are more than the 20 kit reads, which kit draws as the teams stage's in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:teams-read, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::ado_teams and forge::ado_collaborators); every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. The extension reads WebApiTeam, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/core/teams/get-teams?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1.
